title: JournalEntryLineDetail

PostingType.description: Product: ALL Description: Indicates whether the JournalEntry line is a Debit or Credit.[br /]

Entity.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference information for the Entity (Customer/Vendor/Employee) associated with the JournalEntry line.

AccountRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Account associated with the JournalEntry line.

ClassRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Class associated with the JournalEntry line.

DepartmentRef.description: Product: QBO Description: Represents Department Reference associated with the JournalEntry line.

TaxCodeRef.description: Product: QBO Description: Sales/Purchase tax code associated with the JournalEntry Line. For Non US/CA Companies

TaxRateRef.description: Product: QBO Description: Sales/Purchase tax rate Id associated with the JournalEntry Line. For CA Companies.

TaxApplicableOn.description: Product: QBO Description: Indicates whether the tax applicable on the line is sales or purchase

TaxAmount.description: Product: QBO Description: Tax applicable for this line transaction line

TaxInclusiveAmt.description: Product: QBO Description: Indicates the total amount of line item including tax.

BillableStatus.description: Product: ALL Description: The billable status of the journal entry line. The line is to be billed to a customer if the account is an expense account and the Entity Reference specifies a Customer or a Job.[br /]

JournalCodeRef.description: Product: QBO Description: The Journal Code that should be associated for every journal entry line. This is applicable only for FR.

JournalEntryLineDetailEx.description: Product: ALL Description: Internal use only: extension place holder for JournalEntryDetail

description: Product: ALL Description: JournalEntry detail for a transaction line.
